flow.name: axn-term - devin session restore
flow.description: Verify that axn-term remembers and restores the correct devin session name across app restarts.

script.description: Create a temp state dir with a fake devin binary
Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
Close axn-term so state is persisted

assertions.description: The app closed and saved state

script.description: Reopen axn-term and verify the restored session

assertions.description: The correct devin session is restored and only one window exists
